title: Character Encoding Handling Fails for WINDOWS-1252 ADVPL Files
body: I work with a language called ADVPL from the Protheus ERP. The programs used (with .prw and .tlpp extensions) have WINDOWS-1252 encoding. Claude can even edit them, but it replaces the accented characters with special characters. This is likely because it is editing them as UTF-8 files, corrupting the file and replacing the characters with special ones, for example: á, é, í, ç, ã.
author: andrelanzieri
